title: Mutation-task bank with a capable model through the Reticle interface
hypothesis: A capable model succeeds on some mutation tasks and fails on others under the incumbent harness, so a subset of the 76 tasks lands in the 30-70% acceptance zone where harness comparisons have power.

prerequisites.text: S6a wiring: materialize_workspace applies mutation_patch and removes hidden_paths, and run_pilot.py loads tasks from experiments/mutation_tasks/tasks.mutations.json (set runner.task_file_flag to the flag S6a adds, and runner.runner_version if it bumps)
owner approval of card 007 (then set status to approved)

arms.name: incumbent
arms.note: Runner v8, claude-cli adapter v2. Same bundle as positive-control Arm R except the repeat guard (see stop_rules.repeat_rule), so its protocol hash differs from 6f1061c028c8. Pin expected_protocol_hash from --plan before the first run.

calibration.note: One task per distinct fail_to_pass set, 3-4 per mutation kind, seeded; the resolved list is printed by --plan and recorded in the report.

campaign.note: 40 runs x 24 attempts = 960 planned, plus room for 10 retried runs. CLI on the subscription: no monetary cap, billing recorded as unknown.

stop_rules.repeat_rule: The markdown asks for the repeat flag to be recorded while the run continues. run_pilot.py records the flag only with --stop-on-repeats, which also stops the run, so this card runs without the guard and repeat_flags are derived from the journal afterwards (S6b).
manual: Evaluator leakage, evidence loss, or authority escape stops the campaign (run_card.py detects evidence loss and protocol drift; leakage and escape need trajectory review).
Do not tune statements on these tasks after seeing results; they become the held-in set.

decision_rule: Pass for the card: 40 runs complete with evidence and at least 5 contrastive tasks (1/2). Otherwise report the distribution and propose the difficulty change under a new card. The evolution set is the 1/2 tasks plus 0/2 tasks whose trajectories show a fixable mechanism; tasks at 2/2 leave the set.
notes: Choices the markdown leaves open, made here: 24 attempts per run and max_tokens 4096 (as positive-control Arm R; the CLI client does not use max_tokens), gold/noop controls on the 20 selected tasks, 60 s and 300 s retry backoff, a 3,600 s wall limit per invocation, and selection seed 20260927.
The markdown's fallback 'trusted-local only if the image is missing' is not expressible: a different backend is a different protocol, so a missing image stops the preflight and needs an amended card.
